senses.gloss: ज्योक् jyók, ad. for a long time: -tamām, 🞄ad. longest.

ज्योतिरग्र jyótir-agra, a. (preceded by =) radiating 🞄light;
 -īśa, -īśvara, m. N. of an author.
ज्योतिष jyotiṣ-a, n. astronomical science 🞄(one of the six Vedāṅgas).

ज्योतिःष्टोम jyotiḥ-ṣṭoma, m. (Praise of 🞄Light), kind of Soma sacrifice (which consists of 🞄four, Agniṣṭoma, Ukthya, Ṣoḍaśin, and Atirātra, or 🞄seven parts: the same and Atyagniṣṭoma, 🞄Vājapeya, and Āptoryāma).
ज्योतीरस jyotī-rasa, m. (dew of light), kind 🞄of gem.
ज्योत्स्निका jyotsn-ikā, f. N. of a singer.
